text.trigger: One of your survivors took a plain wound on the exposure roll after a move.
text.vignette: The wound is not a scratch from the dead. It is a bullet, and it came from the tree line, from people in winter camouflage who looked fed and rested and were not interested in the shamblers at all. Somebody out there is hunting the living.

options.hunt: Go after them tonight. Every survivor in your group rolls for exposure twice.
options.lieLow: Keep your heads down. From now on every move any player makes also rolls a die: a 1 or 2 means a wound.
